title: EMOM 12: 3 power cleans
creator: Common EMOM template
description: Twelve minutes of 3 power cleans on the minute, 36 quality reps at a moderately heavy load (around 70% of your 1RM). A strength-skill EMOM: the point is bar speed and position under a clock, not fatigue. Drop the load, not the reps, if the third rep gets ugly.
